content: CAN Driver (Can) The CAN driver provides hardware-dependent access to the internal and external CAN controllers (CAN 2.0B, CAN FD, CAN XL). function Can_Write [SWS_CP_CAN_00001] Std_ReturnType Can_Write(Can_HwHandleType Hth, const Can_PduType* PduInfo); Passes a CAN message (standard, extended, or FD frame) to the hardware transmit mailbox (HTH). function Can_Init [SWS_CP_CAN_00002] void Can_Init(const Can_ConfigType* Config); Initializes all configured CAN controllers, baud rates, bit timing registers, and hardware mailboxes. function Can_SetControllerMode [SWS_CP_CAN_00003] Std_ReturnType Can_SetControllerMode(uint8 Controller, Can_ControllerStateType Transition); Transitions controller states between STOPPED, STARTED, and SLEEP. CAN Interface (CanIf) The CanIf abstracts CAN hardware details and provides uniform access to multiple CAN controllers and transceivers for higher-layer modules (PduR, CanTp, CanNm, CanSM). function CanIf_Transmit [SWS_CP_CAN_00011] Std_ReturnType CanIf_Transmit(PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Initiates transmission of a CAN PDU, performing PDU-to-HTH mapping and software transmit queuing if mailboxes are busy. function CanIf_RxIndication [SWS_CP_CAN_00012] void CanIf_RxIndication(const Can_HwType* Mailbox, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Callback invoked by Can driver when a frame arrives; validates CAN ID filtering and dispatches to upper target layers (PduR, CanTp). CAN Transceiver Driver (CanTrcv) Controls physical bus transceiver states and wakeup detection on CAN lines. function CanTrcv_SetOpMode [SWS_CP_CAN_00020] Std_ReturnType CanTrcv_SetOpMode(uint8 Transceiver, CanTrcv_TrcvModeType OpMode); Sets transceiver mode to NORMAL, STANDBY, or SLEEP.
